subject: Strategic subsidy for Chartwell eval — competitive bakeoff extension
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@chartwell.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@chartwell.ai
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Eval timeline + competitive bakeoff

Hi Grace —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We're moving into an internal bakeoff next week where Redwood will be evaluated side-by-side with ApertureAI and another provider. A couple of asks from our side to make the comparison meaningful:

- Can Redwood extend our eval window by 60 days so the team can complete full-scale benchmarks?
- We run several on-prem datasets (PHI-masked) — can you provide a temporary eval credit pool for throughput testing (GPU-backed tokens or equivalent)?
- We need a short statement on data handling for the bench (just to appease procurement/security).

Budget is tight but the head of ML is keen to move fast if performance looks right. If Redwoods can support a sizable token allocation + extension, it would materially help our selection.

Attached: chartwell_eval_scope.pdf (scope + test cases).

Would appreciate a short proposal by EOD today if possible.

—Elena
Elena Morris
Director, ML Engineering
Chartwell Health
elena.morris@chartwell.ai

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@chartwell.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Eval timeline + competitive bakeoff

Hi Elena —

Really appreciate the clarity and the scope document — good test plan. We can support an extended eval and a subsidized pool for benchmark-only traffic. High-level proposal: 

- Extension: +60 days from your current end date (new end-date = 2027-02-15).
- Credit: up to $25k in subsidized usage credit (applied to the evaluation account) plus priority test slots on our dedicated inference pool (for lower latency during runs).
- Conditions: credits are for evaluation/benchmark traffic only; standard TOS applies. We need procurement to sign a short eval addendum (DocuSign) to enable private dataset access and temporary KMS scope.

I've cc'd Vanessa and Ben to speed approvals on the subsidy and budget. If that's acceptable, I'll send the addendum and the proposed subsidy spreadsheet.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min call with your ML lead if they'd like to walk through the perf knobs (KV caching, batching profiles) that will matter for comparison.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Phone: (415) 555-0142

Attachment: proposed-subsidy-pricing.xlsx (pricing and token-to-dollar mapping)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Eval timeline + competitive bakeoff

Grace —

Thanks for the quick turn. I reviewed the scope and proposed subsidy. Approve the extension and a partial credit allocation as follows: 

- Approved credit: $15,000 (applied as eval credit)
- Priority test slots: approved for up to four 2-hour windows during the benchmark period
- Requirement: Chartwell signs the eval addendum and confirms they will not use credits for production traffic.

Ben please confirm payment route for the subsidy and whether we need FC-approval to exceed $10k. I've attached a one-line cost sheet for records.

Quoted for context:
> "We can support an extended eval and a subsidized pool for benchmark-only traffic. High-level proposal: - Extension: +60 days... - Credit: up to $25k..."

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Commercial Programs
Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@chartwell.ai>

Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Eval timeline + competitive bakeoff

Grace / Vanessa —

Thank you both — this is workable. Chartwell accepts the $15k credit and the 60-day extension, conditional on the addendum. Procurement will review the DocuSign; I've looped them on this thread (procurement@chartwell.ai).

Next steps from Chartwell:
- Procurement will sign the addendum (please send the DocuSign link).
- ML team will send a proposed benchmark schedule by Monday so we can reserve your priority slots.
- I'll share a contact for the on-prem data owner who will coordinate KMS access.

We'll also share a one-pager post-bakeoff showing the metrics we used for selection. Looking forward to seeing Redwood in the results.

Best,
Elena
